verdict.rationale: First-party sources state plainly that Svelte is a compiler that turns declarative components into efficient JavaScript that surgically updates the DOM, doing minimal work in the browser (svelte-gh-1, svelte-docs-1, svelte-docs-4). Its reactive state needs no manual update API (svelte-docs-5). Community users corroborate the compile-to-imperative-JS model, readable generated code and real performance gains after migrating from React (svelte-comm-15, svelte-comm-5, svelte-comm-8). Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how the compiler produces fine-grained DOM updates, and independent benchmarks of update efficiency.
